<p align="center"><b>Your OVHcloud VPS and dedicated servers in a Windows app: status, charts, backups, firewall, alerts in the tray.</b></p>

## Download

**[⬇ ovhelm.exe](https://github.com/thadoom/ovhelm/releases/download/v0.2.0/ovhelm.exe)** · Windows 10 and 11 · one file, nothing to install

> [!NOTE]
> Ovhelm is a personal project, not an OVHcloud product. GitHub also adds "Source code (zip / tar.gz)" to every release: that is the repository, you only need `ovhelm.exe`.

## First start

1. Run `ovhelm.exe`. This build is not code-signed yet (the SignPath request is pending), so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
2. Click **Create them on OVHcloud**, log in, pick a validity and confirm: you get three keys.
3. Paste them and press **Save and connect**. They are stored in the Windows Credential Manager, never in a file.

## What's new

**A dashboard you choose**
- Pin CPU, network, status or backups of any server, plus alerts, upcoming renewals and invoices
- The tiles share the window: no scrolling

**Every VPS in one page**
- Reboot, power on and off, KVM console, OS reinstall with your SSH key
- CPU, RAM and network for the last hour, day or week, read from OVHcloud's metrics service
- Automated backup restore points, snapshots, recent tasks

**Dedicated servers, network and account**
- Hardware, traffic, boot and rescue mode, IPMI console
- Reverse DNS, the OVH network firewall and its rules, anti-DDoS status
- Every service with its expiry date, invoices with the PDF

**Knows when a server goes down**
- Closing the window keeps Ovhelm in the tray; a notification arrives when a server stops answering or comes back

**Seven languages**
- English, Italiano, Français, Deutsch, Español, Polski, Português, from the flag button top right

Problems or ideas: [open an issue](https://github.com/thadoom/ovhelm/issues).

### Primo avvio

1. Apri `ovhelm.exe`. Questa versione non è ancora firmata (la richiesta a SignPath è in corso): se SmartScreen dice "Windows ha protetto il PC", clicca **Ulteriori informazioni** e poi **Esegui comunque**.

### Le novità

- **Una dashboard che scegli tu**: puntine su CPU, rete, stato o backup di ogni server, più avvisi, scadenze e fatture, senza scroll.
- **Ogni VPS in una pagina**: riavvio, accensione, console KVM, reinstallazione, grafici di CPU, RAM e rete, backup automatici, snapshot.
- **Dedicati, rete e account**: hardware, traffico, rescue, IPMI, reverse DNS, firewall di rete, anti-DDoS, scadenze e fatture.
- **Sa quando un server si ferma**: resta nella tray e ti avvisa con una notifica.
- **Sette lingue**: dal bottone con la bandiera in alto a destra.
